checks: All 204 Chinese/English ID pairs present and unique
All biographies and individual scientific claims manually compared
Collaborator credit, historical priority, conditions and caveats compared
Canonical date displays and date precision match in all204
Contribution, field and note counts match in everypair
English user-facing fields contain no CJK characters
Image alt and provenance-note wording checked for language and identity
fresh_external_checks_scope: Fresh independent external checks were targeted to ambiguous scientific or biographical points (Wang Ganchang, Maurice Goldhaber, Stanley Deser); the per-record list distinguishes these from existing source references.
limitations: A passed English review means faithful, carefully checked translation of the curated Chinese facts; it is not a claim of worldwide exhaustiveness or infallibility.
Source URLs retained from the Chinese library are not all newly re-fetched by this independent translation-review pass.
